name: asymptomatik
description: ASymptOmatik plugins for Claude Code: memory across sessions (souvenir) and Cheat Engine control (cheatengine)

plugins.name: asymptomatik-souvenir
plugins.description: Keeps every Claude Code conversation (Claude Code deletes its transcripts after 30 days) and searches them by meaning or exact text, with project files

plugins.name: asymptomatik-cheatengine
plugins.description: Drive Cheat Engine from Claude Code: memory scans and edits, pointers, watchpoints, code patches, Mono/Unity inspection, screenshots
